profile.name: Shaheen
profile.overview: Shaheen is a simple, "back-to-basics" character. His game-plan revolves almost entirely around his extremely potent full crouch (FC) mix-up and controlling space through an abundance of great pokes. He has a strong punishment kit, and both a generic df+2 and a hopkick to whiff punish with. He has several strong counterhit tools to dissuade mashing and decent plus frame mids to pressure a defensive opponent.
profile.playstyle: Back to basics with a deadly full-crouch mix-up. Get into a crouch and threaten his Slide (FC.df,d,DF+3), arguably the best power low in the game (Wavu), against his crouching mids. Use Stealth Step (SNK) transitions to keep the turn. From standing his lows are only average, so keep-out characters can give him trouble.
strengths: Powerful full crouch mixup: Slide (FC.df,d,df+3) is arguably the best power low in the game, allowing for a long range mixup that has much more reward than risk.
Consistency is Key: Shaheen's gameplan is very simple, his moves are intuitive, and he has great block and whiff punishment tools.
Heat Wall Pressure: Al-Ghul Master into f+2,3 along with f,f,F+2 and df+3 can turn Shaheen into a menace at the wall while he's in Heat.
Strong Panic Tools: Has the second best hopkick in the game, as well as a powerful safe powercrush.
Grey Health Deletion: Has the rare ability to erase opponent's grey health with easy setups.

Combo Artist: Has very lenient and varied combo routes that allow for good damage, wall carry, or decent okizeme. Also has the ability to easily switch sides during combos, giving him great control over stage positioning.
Agile: Great movement and approach tools.
Solid Counter-hit Tools: Has reliable CH tools in a game where CH tools tend to be weak and risky.
weaknesses: Average standing lows: Since he lacks threatening lows from standing, he struggles against keepout due to his reliance on his full crouch mixup to get significant damage.
Low Combo Damage: Shaheen's combos do somewhat less damage than average, and require high execution for good wall carry.

stances.name: Stealth Step
stances.entry: DF after 3, 2,3, d+3 and others; the Slide transitions on hit
stances.note: SNK.2 and SNK.df+1,2 are used in his combos; SNK.1 is a counter-hit tool (Wavu).

heat: Partially restores Heat time when performing certain knife-hand moves.
